1. Executive Summary & Day 1 Milestone

AqarFlow combines "Aqar" (property/real estate) with "Flow" (seamless operational business workflows) to establish a single reliable source of truth for properties, customers, leads, appointments, and deal commissions in Pakistan.

Within the Day 1 execution window, the end-to-end foundation was delivered: a high-performance Public Property Discovery Portal that captures client inquiries, synchronized directly with an internal Business Workspace (ERP + CRM) featuring interactive Kanban pipelines, algorithmic double-booking protection, and financial receipt generation.

3. Work Breakdown Completed on Day 1

  • Full-Stack Architecture: Engineered Next.js 16 App Router application with dual-portal layout hierarchy, persistent state, and 11 embedded RESTful route handlers under /api/v1.
  • Pakistan Market Localization: Standardized PKR formatting in Crore/Lakh (e.g. PKR 14.5 Crore), land units in Marla/Kanal (225 sq ft/4,500 sq ft), and geographic filtering for Islamabad, Lahore, Karachi, and Rawalpindi.
  • Double-Booking Conflict Engine: Algorithmic scheduler in db.ts and /api/v1/visits that detects overlapping 45-minute booking slots for the same agent, rejecting collisions with HTTP 409 Conflict.
  • CRM & Activity Logging: Integrated communication drawer allowing agents to log phone calls, WhatsApp messages, site meetings, and internal follow-up dates.
  • Deal Pipeline & Financial Accrual: Automated commission calculation engine (1.5% to 3%) linked with a formal, printable Transaction Statement & Token Deposit Receipt.
  • Institutional Audit Trail: Immutable security log tracking all entity modifications, actor roles, timestamps, and IP addresses.
  • 1-Click Demo Role Switcher: Instant switching between Agency Admin (Salman Tariq) and Senior Agent (Ayesha Khan) directly in the UI without retyping credentials.

4. Technical Challenges & Engineering Solutions

Challenge Root Cause Resolution
React 19 Hydration Mismatch Server Node.js on Windows formatted large prices using Indian grouping (14,50,00,000), while browser Chrome used US grouping (145,000,000), causing WhatsApp link query parameters to diverge. Engineered formatNumberFixed(), a deterministic regex formatter immune to OS/browser locale differences, and added suppressHydrationWarning to dynamic anchors.
Missing CSS / Unstyled UI Next.js Webpack mode (used to bypass Windows AppLocker on native binaries) did not invoke Tailwind v4's Rust oxide scanner, emitting empty utility classes. Configured pure-JavaScript Tailwind CSS v3.4 + PostCSS + Autoprefixer with explicit content scanning in tailwind.config.ts, generating the complete 61.5 KB stylesheet.
Visit Double-Booking Overlapping inspection tours booked for the same broker caused scheduling chaos. Implemented time-slot collision detection algorithm rejecting conflicts with actionable notifications.
